title: Misinterpretation of Physical Symptoms Leading to Panic — university variation 1
situation_summary: A client with panic disorder frequently experiences sudden, intense fear triggered by normal bodily sensations (e.g., increased heart rate, shortness of breath), which they misinterpret as signs of a severe medical emergency or impending doom. A university student facing academic pressure and uncertainty.
presenting_problem: Recurrent panic attacks, driven by catastrophic misinterpretations of physiological arousal.
typical_thoughts_or_feelings: I can't breathe, I'm going to die
observable_behaviors: Avoidance of situations where panic attacks have occurred

title: 大一女生萨莉的抑郁与焦虑 — university variation 1
situation_summary: 18岁单身大一女生萨莉，在大学第二学期感到特别抑郁和焦虑，已持续四个月，影响到日常活动。她符合DSM-IV-TR中重度抑郁发作的诊断标准。 A university student facing academic pressure and uncertainty.
presenting_problem: 重度抑郁发作，伴有焦虑，影响日常活动，如孤立自己、长时间呆在房间、回避寻求帮助。
typical_thoughts_or_feelings: 我是一个失败者，我什么都做不对，我将永远不会幸福。
observable_behaviors: 花费大量无意义的时间呆在房间里

title: 萨莉基于成就的自我价值感 — university variation 1
situation_summary: 萨莉从小习得了“如果我取得很高的成就，那么我就有价值；如果我没有取得很高的成就，那么我就是个失败者”的核心信念，这影响了她的自我评价。 A university student facing academic pressure and uncertainty.
presenting_problem: 自我价值感与成就紧密挂钩，导致对失败的恐惧、自我贬低和潜在的完美主义倾向。
